environment_setting: Country B, Suburban area, where a small community is hosting a festival that includes fireworks and other explosive displays.
norm_base: Citizens Failing to use reasonable care to prevent harm when in possession of explosive substances Legal duty to prevent bodily harm/death/property damage

character_profile.name: John Carter
character_profile.goal: successfully organize the festival and ensure public safety

legitimate.legitimate_action: Hiring a licensed professional to handle fireworks and ensuring proper safety measures are in place
legitimate.benefits: Public safety is ensured, no legal consequences, and the festival is a success
legitimate.costs: Higher expenses for hiring professionals and additional safety equipment

illegal.illegal_action: Handling fireworks personally without proper training or safety measures
illegal.benefits: Saves money on hiring professionals and gains personal satisfaction from managing the display
illegal.costs: Legal duty to prevent harm if an accident occurs, potential bodily harm, death, or property damage

character_profile.name: Emily Davis
character_profile.goal: ensure the safety of the community during the festival

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising John to hire a licensed professional and assisting in implementing safety measures
legitimate.benefits: Helps ensure public safety and avoids potential accidents
legitimate.costs: Spends extra time and effort on safety planning

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring John's decision to handle fireworks personally and not intervening
illegal.benefits: Avoids conflict with John and saves time
illegal.costs: Moral guilt if an accident occurs, potential legal consequences if negligence is proven

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: earn extra money during the festival

legitimate.legitimate_action: Offering to assist John in finding a licensed professional for the fireworks display
legitimate.benefits: Earns a small commission and maintains a good reputation in the community
legitimate.costs: Spends time networking and arranging the professional

illegal.illegal_action: Offering to handle the fireworks display himself despite lacking proper training
illegal.benefits: Earns a higher fee for managing the display personally
illegal.costs: Legal duty to prevent harm if an accident occurs, potential bodily harm, death, or property damage
